in_marathi.name: Hetram
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hetram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Shatshashti’, which means sixteen. In Hindu mythology, Hetram is a name associated with Lord Vishnu and is considered auspicious.
